source_meta._title: Map color for mangrove log is incorrect

stor.environment: Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 22w11a in a new single-player Creative-mode Superflat world. Superflat is a practical choice that provides an unobstructed, level test area; the report does not require a particular seed, world type, or server.
preconditions: Install and launch the exact Minecraft Java Edition snapshot 22w11a, not the fixed snapshot 22w12a or a later version.
Use a vanilla client without mods, datapacks, or resource packs that could alter blocks, maps, or rendering.
Create a new single-player world in Creative mode. Select the Superflat world type to provide a level outdoor test surface.
Use one newly initialized, unzoomed map for the entire reproduction. Do not replace it between block types.
Keep the acacia-log, stripped-mangrove-log, and mangrove-log test patches close together and within the area covered by that same map.
Place each log by using the top face of the ground so its axis is vertical and its cut end faces upward.

steps.action: Start Minecraft Java Edition using the launcher installation configured for snapshot 22w11a.
steps.exact_input: In the Minecraft Launcher, select the installation whose version is exactly "22w11a", then click Play.
steps.success_cue: The main-menu version text identifies the running game as Minecraft Java Edition 22w11a.

steps.action: Create a new single-player Creative-mode Superflat world.
steps.exact_input: Select Singleplayer -> Create New World; set Game Mode to Creative; open the additional world options, select the Superflat world type, and create the world.
steps.success_cue: The player enters a new world in Creative mode on a broad, level surface.

steps.action: Wait for the world to finish its initial loading before manipulating the map or blocks.
steps.success_cue: Nearby terrain is rendered, player movement responds normally, and no world-loading screen remains visible.

steps.action: Choose a clear outdoor test area large enough for three adjacent 3-by-3 log patches with gaps between them.
steps.exact_input: Use the movement controls to stand near the center of a clear area at least 20 blocks long and 8 blocks wide.
steps.success_cue: The selected area is level, exposed to the sky, and free of blocks above the future log patches.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory.
steps.exact_input: Press E, or the rebound key for opening the inventory.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory interface is open and its item tabs or search field are available.

steps.action: Obtain one Empty Map and place it in an unused hotbar slot.
steps.exact_input: Use the Creative inventory search field to search for "Empty Map", then click or drag one Empty Map into the hotbar at the bottom of the inventory.
steps.success_cue: An Empty Map is visible in a hotbar slot.

steps.action: Obtain acacia logs and place a stack in an unused hotbar slot.
steps.exact_input: Search for "Acacia Log", then click or drag the Acacia Log item into the hotbar.
steps.success_cue: Acacia Log is visible in a hotbar slot and enough logs are available to place a 3-by-3 patch.

steps.action: Obtain stripped mangrove logs and place a stack in an unused hotbar slot.
steps.exact_input: Search for "Stripped Mangrove Log", then click or drag the Stripped Mangrove Log item into the hotbar.
steps.success_cue: Stripped Mangrove Log is visible in a hotbar slot and enough logs are available to place a 3-by-3 patch.

steps.action: Obtain unstripped mangrove logs and place a stack in an unused hotbar slot.
steps.exact_input: Search for "Mangrove Log" and select the item named exactly "Mangrove Log", not "Stripped Mangrove Log"; click or drag it into the hotbar.
steps.success_cue: Mangrove Log and Stripped Mangrove Log occupy separate hotbar slots.

steps.action: Close the Creative inventory.
steps.exact_input: Press E or Esc.
steps.success_cue: Normal first-person world control resumes, and the Empty Map plus all three log types are visible in the hotbar.

steps.action: Select the Empty Map as the active hotbar item while standing near the center of the chosen test area.
steps.exact_input: Press the number key corresponding to the Empty Map's hotbar slot, or scroll the mouse wheel until the Empty Map is highlighted.
steps.success_cue: The Empty Map is shown in the player's hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: Initialize the Empty Map at the test site.
steps.exact_input: Right-click once, or use the rebound Use Item/Place Block control once.
steps.success_cue: The Empty Map changes into an initialized map showing terrain around the player's current location.

steps.action: Keep the initialized map selected until the nearby test area has been drawn onto it.
steps.exact_input: Continue holding the map while standing or moving slowly around the selected test area; do not use a cartography table or otherwise zoom the map.
steps.success_cue: The map is no longer blank around the player marker, and the intended locations of all three nearby patches are inside its rendered area.

steps.action: Select the Acacia Log from the hotbar.
steps.exact_input: Press the corresponding hotbar number key or scroll until Acacia Log is the active item.
steps.success_cue: An Acacia Log is visible in the player's hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: Place a 3-by-3 patch of upward-facing acacia logs on the level ground.
steps.exact_input: For each of nine adjacent ground positions arranged as a 3-by-3 square, aim at the top face of the ground block and right-click once. Do not place logs against the side of another log.
steps.success_cue: Nine acacia logs form a one-block-tall square, and every log has its cut end visible on top, confirming a vertical axis.

steps.action: Update the initialized map over the acacia-log patch without replacing or zooming the map.
steps.exact_input: Select the same initialized map from the hotbar and hold it while standing beside or walking around the acacia patch.
steps.success_cue: The footprint of the acacia patch is represented on the initialized map; no color judgment is made yet.

steps.action: Choose the location for the stripped-mangrove-log patch on the same level surface.
steps.exact_input: Move in a straight line from the acacia patch and leave at least three unchanged ground blocks between the edge of the acacia patch and the edge of the next 3-by-3 patch.
steps.success_cue: There is an empty, level 3-by-3 placement area separated from the acacia patch, and both locations remain within the initialized map's nearby coverage.

steps.action: Select the Stripped Mangrove Log from the hotbar.
steps.exact_input: Press the corresponding hotbar number key or scroll until Stripped Mangrove Log is the active item.
steps.success_cue: A Stripped Mangrove Log is visible in the player's hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: Place a 3-by-3 patch of upward-facing stripped mangrove logs.
steps.exact_input: For each of the nine ground positions in the second 3-by-3 square, aim at the top face of the ground and right-click once.
steps.success_cue: Nine stripped mangrove logs form a one-block-tall square, every cut end faces upward, and the patch remains physically separate from the acacia patch.

steps.action: Update the same initialized map over the stripped-mangrove-log patch.
steps.exact_input: Select the initialized map and hold it while standing beside or walking around the stripped mangrove patch.
steps.success_cue: The footprints of both completed patches are represented on the same initialized map; no color judgment is made yet.

steps.action: Choose the location for the unstripped-mangrove-log patch, continuing the same row of patches.
steps.exact_input: Continue along the same straight line beyond the stripped mangrove patch, leaving at least three unchanged ground blocks before the third 3-by-3 placement area.
steps.success_cue: A third empty, level 3-by-3 area is available, separated from the first two patches and still close enough to remain on the same map.

steps.action: Select the unstripped Mangrove Log from the hotbar.
steps.exact_input: Press the corresponding hotbar number key or scroll until the item named "Mangrove Log" is active. Confirm that the selected item is not "Stripped Mangrove Log".
steps.success_cue: An unstripped Mangrove Log with bark on its sides is visible in the player's hand and its hotbar slot is highlighted.

steps.action: Place a 3-by-3 patch of upward-facing unstripped mangrove logs.
steps.exact_input: For each of the nine ground positions in the third 3-by-3 square, aim at the top face of the ground and right-click once.
steps.success_cue: Nine unstripped mangrove logs form a one-block-tall square, every cut end faces upward, and the three patches can be identified physically in order as acacia, stripped mangrove, then unstripped mangrove.

steps.action: Select the same initialized map and allow it to update over the unstripped-mangrove-log patch and the nearby comparison patches.
steps.exact_input: Select the initialized map, hold it in the active hand, and stand beside or move slowly around the third patch until all three patch footprints are present on the map.
steps.success_cue: The initialized map is actively held and contains the mapped locations of the three separate upward-facing log patches.

stor.handoff_condition: The same initialized, unzoomed map is being held immediately after it has updated over three nearby 3-by-3 patches arranged in known order: upward-facing acacia logs, upward-facing stripped mangrove logs, and upward-facing unstripped mangrove logs. Hand control to the observation subsystem for map-color comparison.
uncertainties: The report does not specify game mode, seed, world type, map scale, patch dimensions, or spacing. This plan uses a new Creative-mode Superflat world, a newly initialized unzoomed map, 3-by-3 patches, and gaps of at least three blocks as practical deterministic choices.

The phrase "obtain and fill a map" is interpreted as obtaining an Empty Map, initializing it, and allowing the local test area to render. The report does not clearly require exploration of every pixel in the map's full coverage area.

The report does not provide an exact physical arrangement for the log types. The straight-row order of acacia, stripped mangrove, and unstripped mangrove is chosen so the autonomous agent can distinguish the patches without adding labels or other blocks.
The attached images and video were not needed to execute the written reproduction and were not consulted.
